description: GazeBreak is a lightweight, native macOS focus timer. Pick a work duration, hide the app, and get a fullscreen nudge to rest your eyes when time is up. Built with AppKit, no dependencies.
The Settings window animates away and the app leaves the Dock while the timer runs, then restores itself. Your work and rest durations persist across launches.
The break screen is yours: custom title and message on a fullscreen, always-on-top overlay with a live countdown, progress bar, and Skip button.
